title: Tests leak gpg-agent and scdaemon processes
description: Observed 2026-10-23: ~100 gpg-agent/scdaemon processes left running from pytest homedirs under /tmp/pytest-of-mark (e.g. regulars0/*/gnupg, captains0/verifier), some 40+ minutes old. Fixtures that create GNUPGHOME must kill their agents at teardown (gpgconf --homedir X --kill all) or run gpg with --no-autostart where possible. Applies to tests/migrate and doc tests.
acceptance_criteria: After a full test run, no gpg-agent/scdaemon remains with a pytest homedir; a test or conftest check enforces it.
notes: Also git-vouch-migrate itself leaks: gpg-agent processes with --homedir /tmp/mig-ring.* (its own temp keyrings) stay running after the tool exits; the tool must kill its agent (gpgconf --homedir --kill all) in a finally block. Session scratchpad keyrings also leaked. Mark asked 2026-10-23 to kill them all; cleaned by hand (age > 15 min).
